messages:
emma: Heads-up — seeing apiserver 95p latency spike in eu-west1 around 09:12 UTC. Controller-manager restarted twice during the window. Looks tied to a GPU pool scale-up job that kicked off ~09:10.
raj: Oof. Any logs?
emma: quick snippet from apiserver logs: `E0909 09:12:31.123 apiserver.go:456] handler panic: write tcp 10.4.5.6:443->10.7.8.9:52314: write: connection reset by peer`
lia: Also seeing NAT/egress errors in metrics: `conntrack_used ~ 65k / conntrack_max 65k` around the same time.
matt: deploy-bot shows: `deploy-bot: reserved-capacity/scale-up job id=rc-449 started at 09:09:58, target=8 gpus -> 20 gpus`
ops-bot: alert: apiserver_latency_95p_euw increased from 200ms -> 1.1s (09:11 -> 09:13).
raj: That conntrack ceiling rings true. When GPU nodes come up, they all hit the control plane for certificates/taints/kubelet boot -> fanout QPS spike and lots of ephemeral conn creation. If NAT ports or conntrack are exhausted apiserver proxy path will see resets.
lia: Quick check of nodes: many new nodes in provisioning state, kubelet logs show repeated TLS handshakes.
emma: Controller-manager restarts correlate with apiserver 5xxs; it hits leader election timeouts.
matt: We're currently using bursty on-demand scale-up for pooling. Should we pre-warm the pool or stagger joins? Both have cost implications.
raj: Staggering node join across a 2-3 min window would reduce the fanout. Pre-warm would avoid churn but increases reserved cost.
lia: Short-term mitigation: increase conntrack_max on NAT gateways, and bump apiserver proxy timeouts. Ops script ready?
emma: I'm going to open a quick NAT ramp ticket and a temporary conntrack bump for eu-west1. Lia/Matt can you coordinate stagger policy for the scale-up job tomorrow?
matt: Yep — will add a jitter to the scale-up job (random delay 15-90s) and add a canary 2 node batch first.
raj: Also adding a leader election pod lease jitter patch to controller-manager (small backoff) to avoid synchronous restarts.
ops-bot: incident-note created: INC-2026-0911-euw-apiserver-provision-fanout.
emma: Thanks — action items: 1) conntrack bump (ops) 2) jitter/stagger scale-up (matt) 3) leader-election backoff (raj) 4) follow-up on pre-warm costing (product/finance). I'll monitor next scheduled scale-up at 09:30. :thumbsup:
matt: will post rollout plan in #eng-sre with timings.
lia: Leaving logs + flamegraphs in the incident folder.
emma: closing loop later today with postmortem if it reoccurs.
